eyebrow: A table you didn't fully write
code:
aws ec2 create-route-table \
  --vpc-id vpc-0abc123456789def0

aws ec2 associate-route-table \
  --subnet-id subnet-0abc123456789def0 \
  --route-table-id rtb-0private12345678
caption: Every route table starts with an undeletable local route for the VPC's own CIDR — this adds a custom table on top.

code:
aws ec2 allocate-address --domain vpc

aws ec2 create-nat-gateway \
  --subnet-id subnet-0public123456789 \
  --allocation-id eipalloc-0abc123456789def0
caption: A NAT Gateway lives in a public subnet, not the private one it serves, and needs its own Elastic IP.
